name: AtmosphericEffects
screenshot_assessment: Image Read returned empty in this environment; assessed via pixel stats + OCR. Desktop is 99.1% flat light-grey, 0.0% saturated pixels; only the story's own text ('Atmospheric chart layer / Glow / Particles / Depth') is detectable. The effect itself is not visible: it renders at zIndex:-1 behind the story frame's opaque background.
material_impl: Bespoke inline styles: radial-gradient + color-mix on a prop color, filter: blur(var(--glass-blur-sm|lg)). No shared glass primitive. Intent/elevation/tier props declared but never destructured or used.
motion: Custom requestAnimationFrame loop that calls setParticles every frame (React re-render at 60fps for up to 50 particles) plus a CSS 'pulse' animation. Reduced motion only via isReducedMotion prop; OS prefers-reduced-motion is not read. Particle positions use Math.random (SSR/hydration mismatch if ever server-rendered).
a11y: Decorative, pointer-events none; not aria-hidden. Imports ContrastGuard but never uses it.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style passthrough, dead props (intent, elevation, tier).
ssr: 'use client'; Math.random in effect only (ok). No heavy imports.
fake_complexity: 'Atmospheric' particles are random dots; the only consumer (ModularGlassDataChart) has it commented out.
justification: Orphaned (only reference is commented out in ModularGlassDataChart.tsx:940-944 and 987-993), invisible in its own certification screenshot because of zIndex:-1, and its animation strategy (setState every rAF frame) is a performance anti-pattern. Background atmospherics already exist in a dedicated family; charts should not ship their own particle system.
evidence: src/components/charts/components/AtmosphericEffects.tsx:93-116 rAF loop with setParticles every frame

name: ChartAxis
screenshot_assessment: Desktop is ~100% blank; non-background content occupies a ~28x32px region (OCR: 'Axis'). The Default story renders an absolutely positioned axis inside a centered layout with no sized parent, so it collapses to nothing.
material_impl: createGlassStyle() called on every render only to read borderColor, with fallback var(--glass-border-subtle). Hard-coded px geometry (15px, 40px, 60px, -45px).
motion: None.

ssr: 'use client'; ticks set in useEffect so SSR renders no ticks (flash).
fake_complexity: Fake: ticks are hard-coded sample values 0,20,40...100 / 0..100 with the source comment 'in a real implementation, this would be based on actual data'.
justification: A demo stub with no data input, unused anywhere in source (only re-exported from charts/components/index.ts), and its certification screenshot is effectively empty yet marked 'passed'. A real axis belongs inside the unified chart engine with a scale API.

name: ChartContainer (charts/components)
screenshot_assessment: Plain card with the story's placeholder text 'ChartContainer / This is the default chartcontainer component.' on near-flat grey; no visible glass material (0% saturated pixels).
material_impl: Broken: background is the literal string '${glassStyles.surface?.base || "var(--glass-bg-default)"}' in single quotes (not a template literal, glassStyles undefined), so the declaration is invalid and the surface is transparent. Border hard-coded color-mix white 20%. No backdrop-filter despite blurStrength prop. 'Use createGlassStyle() instead' left as a comment.
motion: transition: all (anti-pattern).
a11y: role=region with hard-coded aria-label 'Chart container' for every instance (non-unique, non-descriptive landmark).

fake_complexity: glassVariant 'dynamic'/'tinted'/'luminous' and blurStrength do nothing.

name: ChartFilters
screenshot_assessment: Story shows three small swatch circles labelled Revenue/Margin/Forecast with faint filters; 0.4% saturated pixels. Story is a swatch demo, not a chart.

motion: None.

name: ChartGrid
screenshot_assessment: Story shows 'Grid Example' with five hand-drawn gradient bars that the story itself supplies; grid lines are barely detectable (0% saturated pixels outside bars). The 'chart' in the screenshot is story-owned markup.
material_impl: SVG lines; color from createGlassStyle().borderColor via resolveChartColor with rgba(148,163,184,0.28) fallback. Uses useId for defs (good).
motion: None.
a11y: Decorative; not aria-hidden.
api: 'style' prop name is reused for line style (solid|dashed|dotted), shadowing the conventional CSSProperties style prop. Fixed 6x8 lines independent of data.
ssr: Safe (useId).
fake_complexity: A <pattern> is defined but never referenced (dead defs).
target: Unified SVG chart engine (single Grid primitive driven by the scale ticks used by GlassChart)
justification: The only sub-primitive that is approximately correct (useId, token-ish color), but it is disconnected from data and unused. Its logic should move into the one chart engine so grid lines align with real ticks.

name: ChartLegend (charts/components)
screenshot_assessment: A single 8px-tall strip of tiny swatches + 'Dataset 1/2/3' text; 0% saturated pixels, so the swatches are rendering near-grey.
material_impl: Bespoke: hard-coded linear-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.72→0.46), border rgba(255,255,255,0.18), inset/drop shadow rgba literals; fallback #0f172a.

ssr: Safe.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: inline legends in GlassAreaChart:708, GlassBarChart:759, GlassLineChart:594, GlassPieChart:453
target: Single public ChartLegend (toggle buttons with aria-pressed, keyboard support) consumed by every chart
justification: Seven different legend implementations exist in this shard alone. This one is unused, keyboard-broken despite announcing role=button, and visually tiny. Keep one legend with real button semantics and shared material.

name: ChartRenderer
screenshot_assessment: Desktop screenshot is 100.0% a single background color: completely blank. The certification JSON still marks it status 'passed' with bodyTextSample containing only skip links. The story passes the wrong data shape (numbers + label/borderColor instead of {name, data:[{x,y}], color}) into a centered layout with no height.
material_impl: None: transparent wrapper, 8px radius. Hard-coded rgba grid/tick colors (226,232,240,0.78 light text that is low-contrast on light surfaces).
motion: Chart.js animation duration is ANIMATION.DURATION.x / 1000, i.e. 0.15-0.5 ms because Chart.js expects ms, so animation is effectively disabled. 'Physics overlay' is an empty div whose transform scales by springValue.
a11y: Sets role=img/aria-label on wrapper and again on the canvas in three places (onResize, afterRender plugin, rAF retry loop). No data table or text alternative. rAF loop retries forever if no canvas appears.
api: datasets/animation/interaction/axis all typed any. chartRefCallback receives the wrapper div, not the Chart.js instance. onChartHover is typed as a MouseEvent handler but is called with a data point. 'heatmap' and 'radar' fall back to Line silently.
ssr: 'use client'; registers chart.js at module scope; renders 'Loading chart...' until mount.
fake_complexity: enablePhysicsAnimation/springValue overlay draws nothing. Area 'fill' requires the Filler plugin, which this file does not register (works only if another module registered it).
justification: Internal-only, has a blank certification screenshot that was marked passed, and its ref contract is wrong (passes a div), which breaks the only consumer's hover/export. It also duplicates GlassDataChart's chart.js wrapper. Remove along with ModularGlassDataChart.

name: ChartTooltip
screenshot_assessment: A small dark slab (~116x60px) at the top-left reading 'Revenue / January: 12500'. Readable, but it is an opaque near-black box (rgba 15,23,42,0.92), not glass.
material_impl: Bespoke opaque rgba backgrounds (0.92/0.96/0.9), rgba borders, hard-coded 'white'/'black' text, default color #70d6ff. No backdrop blur despite 'frosted' naming.
motion: None.
a11y: No role=tooltip; position: fixed with no viewport clamping (it can overflow at the right/bottom edge); '●' glyph is announced. A value of 0 renders 'N/A' because of the || fallback.
api: datasets/qualityTier/followCursor/children accepted but unused.
ssr: Safe.
fake_complexity: tooltipStyle 'frosted' is not frosted.
target: Single chart tooltip built on the shared GlassTooltip/positioning primitive
justification: Six tooltip variants exist across the chart family. This one is opaque, unclamped, drops zero values, and ignores half its props. Merge into one positioned, glass-material tooltip.

name: KpiChart
screenshot_assessment: Small tile (~164x108px) with '$1,250.00 / Revenue / ↑12.5%' on flat grey; no visible accent, no glass depth (0% saturated). Generic stat card.
material_impl: createGlassStyle({neutral, level2}) spread as inline style (shared mixin, good). Change colors hard-coded #34d399/#f87171; accent var set but never consumed. Spacing uses `${BORDER_RADIUS.sm}px`, which yields the invalid '0.125rempx' (a radius token misused as margin).
motion: animation prop (stiffness/damping/mass) accepted and ignored; no motion.
a11y: Change is conveyed by color + arrow glyph only; no sr-only 'increase/decrease' text. Value is not semantically tied to its label (no dl/aria).
api: Currency hard-coded USD/en-US; qualityTier/isReducedMotion unused.
ssr: Safe; toLocaleString can differ between server and client locales.
fake_complexity: 'animation' physics props are ignored.
justification: A minimal KPI tile that duplicates the dashboard KPI card, with dead animation props and a token misuse that produces an invalid margin. Fold it into GlassKPICard.

name: GlassAreaChart
screenshot_assessment: Card titled 'Sample Area Chart' with two pale overlapping fills and legend 'Revenue / Expenses'; 91% flat grey, under 0.5% saturated pixels, so the fills are washed out. OCR finds month labels but not the 'Time'/'Value' axis titles the story sets, consistent with the HTML-in-SVG bug below. Reads as a generic SVG chart in a card, not a first-party material.
material_impl: GlassCard shell (shared). Plot is bespoke SVG with a duplicated hard-coded 10-color hex palette. Tooltip uses glass-surface-overlay + glass-backdrop-blur-md classes. Several referenced classes do not exist in shipped CSS: glass-text-primary-glass-opacity-30/50/80, glass-drop-glass-shadow-sm, glass-hover-r-6, glass-radial-reveal, glass-lift, glass-chart, glass-animate-pulse, plus dynamic arbitrary classes like glass-duration-[300ms].
motion: CSS animation names areaFill, drawLine, fadeInPoint are referenced but no matching @keyframes exist, so nothing animates. Motion preset='fadeIn' wrapper (Motion primitive handles reduced motion). No reduced-motion handling for the inline animations.
a11y: Data points are role=button tabIndex=0 circles (r=4, about 8px hit target) and only shown when showPoints is set; with the default showPoints=false the chart has no keyboard path. Axis titles are rendered as <ContrastGuard> (an HTML span) inside SVG <text>; in the SVG namespace the span is an unknown element, so the axis-title text is not painted. Legend items are hover-only divs. The SVG has no role/title.
api: React.FC (no forwardRef). Fixed numeric width/height plus preserveAspectRatio='none', so text and strokes distort when the container width differs from `width`. The tooltip is positioned in viewBox units as CSS px (misaligned when scaled). ...props spread onto GlassCard but not typed.
ssr: 'use client'; gradient ids `area-gradient-${s.id}` collide across instances that share series ids.
fake_complexity: Animation durations and stagger are computed for keyframes that do not exist.
justification: Functional SVG area chart with stacking, but its animations reference non-existent keyframes, axis titles are invisible because of HTML-in-SVG, it stretches via preserveAspectRatio='none', and it shares most of its code with GlassLineChart. Merge Line/Area/Bar/Pie into one scale-based engine with responsive measurement, then polish the material there.
evidence: src/components/charts/GlassAreaChart.tsx:474,493,537 areaFill/drawLine/fadeInPoint, no @keyframes in src (only 'pulse' at src/styles/animations.css:199)
src/components/charts/GlassAreaChart.tsx:157,328 padding object recreated each render while listed in useMemo deps (memo always recomputes)

name: GlassBarChart
screenshot_assessment: 400x300 card with saturated cyan/violet bars (2% saturated pixels, the most color in the SVG family) and legend 'Series 1 / Series 2'. OCR finds no axis tick labels: AXIS_TEXT_FILL is rgba(226,232,240,0.78), a light slate on a light card, which makes the labels near-invisible. Square bars with no radius and no material on the bars.
material_impl: GlassCard shell; bespoke SVG. Hard-coded light-on-dark axis colors (rgba 226,232,240) regardless of theme; duplicated palette; same set of non-existent utility classes as the Area chart.
motion: barGrow keyframes referenced but not defined, so no animation. The loading skeleton uses Math.random() heights (hydration mismatch, and it re-randomizes on every render).
a11y: Bars are plain <rect> with mouse handlers only: no focus, no role, no labels. Legend items are focusable listitems whose Enter key toggles highlight (ok) but carry no state semantics. Data labels are again ContrastGuard spans inside <text>, which do not render.
api: React.FC; same fixed width/height and preserveAspectRatio='none' distortion; horizontal orientation supported.
ssr: 'use client'; Math.random in the loading render path.
fake_complexity: None beyond the dead animation.
justification: Bars cannot be reached by keyboard, axis text is tuned for dark surfaces and disappears on light ones, data labels do not render, and the grow animation does not exist. Its grouping math is reusable inside a unified engine.

name: GlassChart (+ ConsciousGlassChart, PredictiveGlassChart, AdaptiveGlassChart, ImmersiveGlassChart, withChartConsciousness, ChartConsciousnessPresets)
exported_note: Only GlassChart is root-exported; the Conscious/Predictive/Adaptive/Immersive variants are module-level exports used by stories and src/tests/consciousness.
screenshot_assessment: Default story: a glass container holding a nested GlassCard holding a pale line chart (99% flat grey, 0.1% saturated pixels; OCR reads only '140'). Two stacked surfaces (container + GlassCard) produce a double-bordered, low-contrast look. Not premium.
material_impl: CSS module container: color-mix surface, border, backdrop-filter blur(--aura-glass-neutral-level3-backdrop-blur), elevation shadow vars. It wraps GlassArea/Bar/Line/PieChart, which bring their own GlassCard, so glass is nested in glass. SimplifiedChartView hard-codes rgba(124,211,255) and a global gradient id 'glass-chart-simplified-fill'.
motion: useReducedMotion is read but only gates magneticEffectProps, which is never used. magneticProps, zAnimationResult (depth animation) and useGlassPerformance are hard-coded no-op objects. The focus mode transform scale(1.02) has no reduced-motion guard.
a11y: The container has role='img' while containing interactive buttons, which removes the toolbar from the accessibility tree. The container's onClick toggles focus mode, so a click anywhere (including toolbar buttons) toggles it. Type-switch buttons have only a title (no aria-label/aria-pressed) and the CSS module has no :focus-visible style. Tabs render the placeholder text 'Tabs: {currentTab}'. Emoji strings ('💡 Insights', '🧠 Adapted for … cognitive load', '🔄 Analyzing…') are injected into the UI.
api: forwardRef + imperative handle (good intent). Hooks are called conditionally (predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null, and so on), which violates the Rules of Hooks and crashes when a flag toggles at runtime. The renderChart useCallback omits commonProps from its deps (stale sizes). width='100%' becomes a hard-coded 640 for children. downloadChart is a no-op without onDownload. theme prop is validated, then ignored.
ssr: 'use client'. Imports five 'advanced' consciousness modules (PredictiveEngine, Achievements, BiometricAdaptation, EyeTracking, SpatialAudio) into every chart bundle.
fake_complexity: Severe. Eye tracking: the gaze handlers are defined but their registration is commented out, so currentDataFocus never changes. 'Predictive insights' are UI-interaction insights from the predictive engine, not analysis of the chart data. Biometric 'cognitive load' equals stressLevel. preloadData's body is commented out. Magnetic and depth effects are empty objects. The 'performance tier' is a constant.
target: Becomes the single public chart API: one SVG/scale engine with type='line|area|bar|pie|donut|scatter', a real legend/tooltip, a data-table fallback, no consciousness layer
justification: Most of the 2,163 lines are theatre: consciousness hooks that do nothing, conditional hook calls, no-op magnetic/depth/performance stubs, placeholder tabs, a no-op download, and a role='img' that hides its own controls. The idea of one facade over chart types is right, and it is the natural flagship slot after a rewrite, but nothing in this implementation should be carried forward except the data normalisation helpers (normalizePoint, transformChartJsData).
evidence: src/components/charts/GlassChart.tsx:1724,1735 onClick + role='img' on the container holding buttons
src/components/charts/GlassChart.tsx:1559-1560,1678-1688 width fallback 640 and missing commonProps dep

name: GlassDataChart (also exported as DataChart)
screenshot_assessment: Wide card 'Activation cohort / Daily conversion and retention…' with legend 'Activation / Retention' and a pale canvas line chart (97% flat grey, 0.2% saturated pixels). Legible header; the plot is low-contrast Chart.js defaults inside a frosted card. Competent but generic.
material_impl: Private ChartContainer with a CSS module backdrop-filter via the --glass-data-chart-backdrop-filter var; variant backgrounds are hand-written color-mix + rgba gradients; createGlassStyle for buttons. Hard-coded axis colors rgba(226,232,240,0.86). An svgFilters block (gradients/glow) is rendered but cannot affect a canvas.
motion: Default animation.duration = ANIMATION.DURATION.normal/1000 (sub-millisecond in Chart.js ms), so it is effectively off. pathAnimationPlugin looks for element._path.getTotalLength, which does not exist on canvas elements (dead code). usePhysicsAnimation and useChartPhysicsInteraction are local no-op stubs that shadow the real exported hook (src/components/charts/hooks/useChartPhysicsInteraction). Reduced motion comes from useAccessibilitySettings, plus a CSS @media rule.
a11y: Canvas with aria-label only; no data table or keyboard access to points. Legend items are divs with onClick only (no role, tabIndex or keys). ZoomControls render real buttons with aria-labels, but the handlers are no-ops. role='group' container (ok).
api: forwardRef exposes the Chart.js instance. Dead props: showToolbar, allowDownload, allowTypeSwitch, renderExportButton and kpi are accepted but no toolbar, type switch or export button is ever rendered (handleExportChart and handleTypeChange are unreachable). variant='kpi' renders a Chart.js bar chart, not a KPI. LegendItem receives $style='default' as a CSS background value. The props interface is not exported.
ssr: 'use client'. Module-scope side effects: ChartJS.register is called twice, and the global Chart.js defaults are mutated (tooltip disabled, font family 'Aeonik', defaults.color/borderColor set to CSS color-mix/var strings that canvas cannot parse), which silently changes every other Chart.js chart in the host app. package.json declares sideEffects only for CSS, so bundlers may drop these registrations. Pulls chart.js and react-chartjs-2 into the root barrel; chart.js is a hard dependency while react-chartjs-2 is both a dependency and an optional peer.
fake_complexity: 'Physics-based interactions' are stubs returning constants; the zoom/pan UI does nothing; the SVG glow filters never apply to the canvas; the 'quality tier' only toggles blur stdDeviation in unused filters.
target: Redesigned GlassChart (optionally a thin, opt-in chart.js adapter on a separate subpath, e.g. aura-glass/charts-chartjs)
justification: It renders a usable canvas chart with a decent header, but about half the advertised surface (toolbar, export, type switching, KPI, zoom, physics) is unreachable or stubbed, and it mutates global Chart.js defaults at import time, which is unacceptable for a library. Deprecate in favour of the unified engine; if canvas rendering is needed for large datasets, ship it as an opt-in adapter without global mutation.
evidence: src/components/charts/GlassDataChart.tsx:716-728 global Chart.js defaults mutated at module scope
src/components/charts/GlassDataChart.tsx:1816,1446-1453 hover writes a new Map into state, which is a chartOptions memo dep, so options are rebuilt on every hovered point

name: GlassLineChart (+ GlassChartContainer)
exported_note: GlassChartContainer (line 651) is not root-exported and has no consumers.
screenshot_assessment: 'Pipeline velocity' card with two thin lines, small points and a legend 'Revenue / Target'; OCR reads the axis ticks (179k…84k, Jan…Jun), so labels are legible though faint. 95% flat grey, 0.4% saturated pixels: thin strokes, no fill, no emphasis. The best-reading SVG chart here, but still a stock look.
material_impl: GlassCard shell; bespoke SVG; hard-coded light-on-dark axis fills; duplicated palette; an unused gradient def per series; non-existent utility classes (same list as Area).
motion: drawLine/fadeInPoint keyframes undefined, so no animation.
a11y: Points have mouse handlers only (no focus, role or label), so a keyboard user has no access to values. Axis titles are ContrastGuard spans inside <text> and do not render. The legend is focusable with Enter toggling highlight.
api: React.FC; fixed width/height + preserveAspectRatio='none'; straight-segment lines only (no curve option).
ssr: 'use client'; gradient id `gradient-${s.id}` collides across instances.
fake_complexity: None beyond the dead animation.
justification: The most usable of the SVG trio, but it is a copy of GlassAreaChart minus the fill, with the same dead animations, distortion and missing keyboard access. Merge into one engine; drop GlassChartContainer (yet another container).

name: GlassPieChart (+ GlassDonutChart)
screenshot_assessment: 'Customer mix' with a saturated blue/green/orange pie (4.2% saturated pixels, the most vivid chart in the shard) and a legend reading 'Enterprise 48% (48%) / Mid-market 27% (27%)…'. The percentage is printed twice because the story's formatValue already returns a percent. Flat, opaque wedges with a 1px white stroke; no glass treatment.
material_impl: GlassCard shell; the donut hole fills with var(--glass-bg-default); hard-coded light label fills rgba(226,232,240) and rgba(248,250,252) (center 'Total' text is near-white on a light surface); duplicated palette.
motion: pieSegment keyframes undefined (applied twice, on <g> and <path>); legend uses Motion preset='slideUp' with stagger (Motion respects reduced motion).
a11y: Segments are mouse-only paths (no focus or labels). The tooltip is positioned with getBoundingClientRect viewport coordinates inside an absolute container, so it lands at the wrong place whenever the page is scrolled or the chart is offset. Legend items have no keyboard support. Center/segment labels are ContrastGuard spans inside SVG <text>/<tspan>, so the donut 'Total' text and slice labels are not painted.
api: forwardRef (good); size prop instead of width/height (inconsistent with siblings); innerRadius in px for the pie but ratio for the donut.
ssr: Safe.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Visually the strongest chart in the shard, but a single 100% segment renders nothing (an arc whose start and end points coincide), donut center text does not render, the tooltip is mis-positioned, and segments are not reachable by keyboard. Its arc math and legend-with-values layout are worth porting into the unified engine.

src/components/charts/GlassPieChart.tsx:249-256 viewport rect used for absolute tooltip

name: ModularGlassDataChart (+ Conscious/Predictive/Adaptive/ImmersiveModularGlassDataChart, ModularChartConsciousnessPresets)
screenshot_assessment: Wide frame (about 984x340px) with grey bands; OCR finds no text at all even though the story sets the title 'Forecast accuracy', toolbar labels and legend labels, which indicates the text is too low-contrast to read or did not render. 0.2% saturated pixels: no visible series color. Story datasets use borderColor/backgroundColor keys that this component ignores (it reads style.lineColor).
material_impl: styles/ChartContainerStyles ChartContainer: computes a blur value but never applies it (no backdrop-filter at all); shadow rgba literals per elevation; the default gridColor is the literal string '${glassStyles.surface?.base…}' (the same quoting bug as charts/components/ChartContainer).
motion: A custom rAF/setInterval tween writes setAnimationValues every frame for 'chart-mount'; the result only scales the empty overlay div in ChartRenderer. Reduced motion via useAccessibilitySettings.
a11y: Legend items are not interactive at all, and every legend item is rendered inactive (dimmed) by default because isActive = selectedIndices.includes(index). Type buttons have no aria-pressed and no focus-visible style. Canvas has no text alternative.
api: chartRef receives ChartRenderer's wrapper div, so handleChartHover calls div.getElementsAtEventForMode (TypeError on hover) and handleExport reads div.canvas (TypeError on Export). handleDataPointClick references the global `event`. Conditional hooks (predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null …) plus an unconditional second usePredictiveEngine call. Several props typed `as any`.
ssr: 'use client'; window access only in handlers; registers chart.js at module scope.
fake_complexity: Severe. 'Insights' are always set to []; gaze handlers are commented out; preload is commented out; AtmosphericEffects and ChartFilters are commented out; 'adaptive cognitive load' equals stressLevel.
justification: Not publicly exported, has no in-repo consumers, crashes on hover and export because of the div-as-chart ref, renders every legend item as disabled, and is a third copy of the chart.js wrapper plus the consciousness theatre. Its certification 'pass' is not credible given the textless screenshot.
evidence: src/components/charts/ModularGlassDataChart.tsx:1150 chartRefCallback stores what ChartRenderer passes (a div: ChartRenderer.tsx:330-334)

name: ChartContainerStyles (ChartContainer, ChartHeader, ChartTitle, ChartSubtitle, createChartContainerStyles)
material_impl: Hand-written rgba/color-mix backgrounds and shadow ladders; the blur variable is computed (getBlurValue) but never applied, and the CSS module has no backdrop-filter, so the 'glass' container is an opaque-ish card. createChartContainerStyles uses #1a1a1a/#e0e0e0/#666666 literals and is unused.
motion: transition: transform/box-shadow in the module.
a11y: Heading level fixed at h3.
api: Transient $-props pattern copied from styled-components without styled-components.
ssr: Safe.
fake_complexity: blurStrength is accepted and discarded.
justification: Internal styling helper used only by ModularGlassDataChart (slated for removal); duplicates four other chart containers and drops its blur parameter. The createChartContainerStyles factory is dead.

name: ChartElementStyles (ChartToolbar, ChartTypeSelector, TypeButton, ToolbarButton, EnhancedExportButton, ChartLegend, LegendItem, LegendColor, LegendLabel, createChartElementStyles, getColorPalette)
material_impl: CSS module with backdrop-filter level1 on toolbar/legend; JS factories with hex literals (#334155, #cbd5e1, #475569). The bar style computes rx from parseFloat('0.875rem') = 0.875, a rem token treated as px.
motion: None of note.
a11y: TypeButton has no aria-pressed and the module defines no focus-visible styles; the export button prepends an emoji icon.
api: getColorPalette returns the same slice for all three themes (meaningless branching). createChartElementStyles is unused.
ssr: Safe.
fake_complexity: Theme branching that returns identical palettes.
target: Shared chart toolbar/legend primitives inside the redesigned GlassChart (use the library SegmentedControl/ToggleGroup for the type switch)
justification: Only ModularGlassDataChart uses these. The toolbar/legend markup is a reasonable starting point but duplicates GlassChart's module CSS and lacks pressed/focus states. Move the useful pieces into the unified chart and delete the dead factories.

name: TooltipStyles (GlassTooltipContainer, TooltipHeader/Body/Item/Label/Value/Separator/Footer, createTooltipStyles, calculateTooltipPosition, formatTooltipValue)
material_impl: color-mix overlays and border/shadow strings; a duplicate createTooltipStyles object factory with black 85% backgrounds.

name: GlassTypingIndicator
screenshot_assessment: Story-composed chat card ('Design review / Can we ship the clearer glass surface today? / Yes, checking…') with the indicator reading 'Maya and Ari are typing ...'. 0% saturated pixels. When users are shown, the component renders text plus three '.' characters and no dots, so the default story never shows the animated dot treatment.
material_impl: OptimizedGlass primitive with an elevation prop (the correct shared primitive). Dot colors use raw Tailwind classes (bg-blue-500, bg-purple-500, bg-green-500, bg-yellow-500, bg-red-500) that do not exist in the shipped CSS (only bg-blue-500/50 exists, in storybook-utility-shim.css). Every non-'neutral' dot color is therefore transparent, so the default primary dots are invisible.
motion: Uses Tailwind animate-bounce (not defined anywhere in shipped CSS) and animate-pulse (defined only in storybook-utility-shim.css); glass-animate-pulse on the ellipsis is not defined. The 'wave' keyframes are injected into document.head at module import time. useReducedMotion() is called but its value is never used, so reduced motion is not wired.
a11y: role=status + aria-live=polite + aria-label (good). The aria-label duplicates visible text; dots are aria-hidden (good). The consumer aria-label overrides it because props spread last (ok).
api: forwardRef, className passthrough, extends HTMLAttributes (good). Sizes sm/md/lg match conventions. The `text` template supports {users}/{isAre}. Mixed class vocabularies (glass-* vs raw Tailwind w-2/h-2/rounded-full/inline-flex/gap-1.5). A duplicate unused `animations` const at module scope.
ssr: 'use client'; module-scope document.head mutation guarded by typeof document (runs on import, undeclared side effect given package.json sideEffects); no heavy imports.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: src/components/social/GlassPresenceIndicator.tsx (own typing indicator at :320, driven by Math.random presence simulation at :109)
justification: The right shape for a chat primitive (OptimizedGlass, forwardRef, live region, small API), but the shipped CSS lacks the classes it depends on, so dots are transparent and do not bounce outside Storybook, and reduced motion is read and then ignored. Fix by moving dot color and animation to tokens and glass-* CSS (with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback to static dots), showing dots alongside the user text, and removing the runtime style injection. GlassPresenceIndicator should then reuse it.
evidence: src/styles/storybook-utility-shim.css:585 only bg-blue-500/50 exists; no .bg-blue-500, no .animate-bounce in src/styles
